metadata.title: Double Exposure Portrait with Landscape Inlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast monochrome double exposure featuring a profile silhouette of a man in a tuxedo. The interior of the silhouette contains a second, full-body image of a man standing with arms outstretched against a misty forest and mountain landscape.
coreVisualRelationships: Profile silhouette acting as a frame for the internal landscape
Contrast between the sharp tuxedo collar and the soft organic trees
Symmetry of the internal figure centered within the profile's head space
Horizontal text line bisecting the verticality of the silhouette
coreInvariants: Strict black and white color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large profile head occupies the center-right, extending from the bottom edge; small full-body figure centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark bow tie at the bottom center provides a heavy base for the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bow tie, move up the silhouette to the central figure, then follow the horizontal text line across the face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive white space surrounding the silhouette emphasizes the profile's contour.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background for high-key isolation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the tuxedo and silhouette shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays within the landscape and shirt textures.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between the background and the subject.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Mirrored 'G' and 'R' characters to create a symmetrical visual rhythm

composition.relationshipToImage: Layered over the landscape but behind the profile's outer edge

treatment.fill: Solid black and white (inverted based on background)

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with extreme tracking and character manipulation.

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric basis allows for clean mirroring and wide tracking.
Modern, clean proportions that maintain legibility at wide tracking.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a high-contrast monochrome double exposure. The primary layer is a profile silhouette of a man in a tuxedo against a white background. The secondary layer, visible only inside the silhouette, is a man standing with arms out in a misty forest landscape.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a single line of geometric sans-serif text horizontally across the middle. Use extreme tracking so letters span the width of the silhouette. Mirror every other character for a symmetrical effect.

verificationChecks: Is the landscape contained strictly within the silhouette?
Is the text tracking wide enough to touch both sides of the head?
Are the mirrored characters correctly oriented?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no color bleed; must be pure grayscale.
Check that the text does not obscure the central figure's face.
Verify the tuxedo collar is sharp and distinct.
Confirm the background is blown out to pure white.
recipe.reuseFormula: Profile Silhouette + Landscape Infill + Wide-Tracked Mirrored Sans-Serif = Conceptual Monochrome Portrait
